LIFE LEVEL — Home & Gear

Two takes on the region-glance home + the Gear board + a compact list fallback.

1. Region card — the map section is a card at the top: current position on top, next zone below. No full trail.
2. Region tree + portal — the earlier callback: the active region's tree fills the middle, the trail pours into a green portal, the region card emerges through it.

All on the app's dark palette, from real in-app art.

HOME — REGION CARD  (current + next zone)

The map section sits at the TOP as a card, not a bottom-anchored full map.

• Region status: 🌲 Forest of Endurance · Chapter 1, zone 2 of 8, Warden 4d.
• Just the two zones that matter — YOU ARE HERE · Misty Pine (current, on top) → a dashed connector down to Dawn Camp (NEXT · 3.0 km) with a 1.0/3.0 km bar and +320 XP.
• 'Open full map' button for the whole node trail.
• Activity items (Claim / Banked km / Today XP / Shields / Streak) as a horizontal strip under the card; Quests + Alerts as header buttons.
• Rest-at-camp scene, Travel here / Log / Sync, bottom nav.

HOME — REGION TREE + PORTAL  (callback to the earlier version)

The active region's tree fills the middle of the screen (zone_thornwood_forest), the trail runs up it past node pins (YOU · Dawn Camp diamond · locked dots), then pours down into a glowing green PORTAL — the doorway onto the full map.

• The region status card (Dawn Camp · Chapter 1 · node 2/8 · 3.0 km · +320 XP · progress dots) emerges through the portal.
• Side rails kept: Claim / Banked km / Today XP / Shields / Streak on the left; Quests + Alerts on the right (Bag removed).
• Campfire hero below, run chips (3.0 km · +320 XP · Standard) above Travel here / Log / Sync.

GEAR — HEX LOADOUT + HERO PANEL

The placeholder class badge is a proper HERO PANEL: avatar in a purple level-ring, class emblem, name + 'Lv 4 · Warrior', a Veteran rank chip + Champion title chip, Power, and an Ember-set tracker.

• 5 equipment slots as a hex cluster with rarity-coloured frames + 'Lv X' pills + slot captions (Head / Chest / Hands / Feet / Accessory); the 6th hex is an empty '+' Trinket slot.
• Stat panel: POWER 1,240 headline + all five stat gems with base value and green gear-bonus.
• Sub-tabs: Titles / Cosmetic / Mounts / Transmog (last two locked).
• Inventory: Gear / Hero toggle + sort, a selected-item detail strip (EPIC rarity, +stats, Equip), then a rarity-tinted 4-col grid.

HOME — COMPACT ALT  (list style, fallback)

The current app layout, minimally changed.

• Combat Power strip under the streak row (purple gem + 1,240 + '+18 last workout' + Details).
• Quests section removed; the active-quest signal is the '!' on the Quests nav tab.
• A Week 3 Expedition strip fills the gap; 7-day dots on the login card.
